title: Legacy Business Insights admin portal: activation, profile, remote assistance, roles, admins, audit logs and ZIA sync pages

prose.label: Your account.
prose.text: {{initial-super-admin}} {{profile-settings}} {{profile-timezone}} The audit log CSV timezone differs {{divergence:csv-export-timezone}}. {{password-change-session}} {{table-settings}}

Sign-in, password expiration, SCIM and SAML are in [[business-insights.legacy.authentication]], and Workflow Automation tenants are in [[business-insights.legacy.workflow]]. The area hub is [[business-insights.legacy]].

activation-two-step.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Configuration changes are saved and then activated to push them to the Central Authority; with concurrent edits of one setting only the last saved configuration persists, and activated changes cannot be undone, only deleted or modified and activated again.

quotes: When multiple users edit a configuration setting concurrently, only the last saved configuration persists.
Activating the changes effectively pushes the configuration changes to the Central Authority (CA)
After you activate your configuration updates, you cannot undo them. However, you can delete or modify the undesired configuration and activate it again.
Make your configuration changes (e.g., adding, editing, or deleting admins), and save the changes on the local database.

activation-queue.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, If other admins are still editing, an admin's activation is queued and pushed to the CA after all admins activate; a queued activation cannot be canceled, only super admins can Force Activate, and saved changes are activated automatically after 30 minutes of inactivity or on logout.

quotes: If there are multiple admins editing, the service pushes the changes to the CA after all admins activate their changes.
A queued activation cannot be canceled.
Force Activate: Immediately pushes all saved changes to the CA. Only super admins can Force Activate changes.
The Zscaler service automatically activates an admin's saved changes if the admin is inactive for 30 minutes or logs out of the portal.

activation-statuses.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, My Activation Status shows No Activations Pending, Editing or Activation Queued.

quotes: No Activations Pending: You haven't saved or activated your changes.
Editing: You saved your changes but haven't activated them.
Activation Queued: Your activated changes are pending and haven't been pushed to the CA.

single-browser-session.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Making changes across multiple browser sessions with the same admin account can cause activation errors.

quotes: If you make changes across multiple browser sessions using the same admin account, activation errors can occur.

initial-super-admin.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Zscaler Support configures a super admin role with access to all functions in the portal, and the portal shows an EUSA on first login.

quotes: Zscaler Support configures a super admin role, which has access to all the functions in the Business Insights Admin Portal
When you log in for the first time, the Business Insights Admin Portal displays a EUSA.

profile-settings.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, The My Profile password must be at least 8 ASCII characters with a number, an uppercase character and a special character, the portal defaults to English with French, German, Japanese, Spanish or Simplified Chinese available, and Auto Refresh Dashboard refreshes every 15 minutes.

quotes: The password must contain at least 8 characters and include one number, one uppercase character, and one special character. Only ASCII characters are allowed.
By default, the Business Insights Admin Portal is displayed in English. You can change the language to French, German, Japanese, Spanish, or Simplified Chinese.
Auto Refresh Dashboard?: Enable to automatically refresh the dashboards every 15 minutes.

profile-timezone.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, The service saves transactions in UTC, and the profile time zone is used only when exporting logs to CSV files.

quotes: When the Zscaler service saves transactions, it uses UTC (Coordinated Universal Time). The time zone is used only for exporting logs to CSV files.

password-change-session.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, After an admin changes their password, the current portal session expires and the service prompts a login with the new password.

quotes: After you change your password, the current Business Insights Admin Portal session expires, and the service prompts you to log in using the new password.

remote-assistance.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Remote Assistance lets Zscaler Support log in with view-only or full admin privileges until a chosen date, without new admin accounts or shared passwords; Zscaler recommends at least one year for view-only and at least two days for full access.

quotes: This can be done with either view-only or full admin privileges. You do not need to create new admin accounts or share passwords to enable access for either option.
Zscaler recommends that you select a length of at least one year when choosing view-only access and at least two days when choosing full access.
you can allow Zscaler Support to securely and remotely log in to the portal.
This procedure allows Zscaler Support to access the portal until the specified date.

remote-assistance-usernames.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, The Remote Assistance User Names option defaults to Visible, SSO users cannot change it, and only admins whose role enables Remote Assistance Management can change the Remote Assistance window.

quotes: Select either Obfuscated or Visible for the User Names option. By default, this is set to Visible.
The SSO users cannot change this setting. Only admin users with Remote Assistance Management enabled for their role can make changes in the Remote Assistance window.

table-settings.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Table column settings are kept in the browser's local storage and are lost if the cache is cleared or another browser is used; tables under Administration pages must keep at least one column visible.

quotes: If you clear your cache or use a different browser, your settings are lost.
For tables under Administration pages, you must have at least one column visible at all times.
the settings are stored in your browser's local storage so that your changes are preserved the next time you log in.

default-roles.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Zscaler provides a default super admin role with full access to the portal, and default admin roles can only be viewed, not edited.

quotes: Zscaler provides a default super admin role that has full access to the Business Insights Admin Portal.
You can only view default admin roles, and they cannot be edited.

role-permission-values.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, A role's permissions are Full (view, add, edit, delete), View Only, None, Visible or Obfuscated, depending on the feature.

quotes: Full: Allows admins to view, add, edit, and delete items.
View Only: Allows admin view-only access to the feature.
Visible: Allows admin to view specific data in the Business Insights Admin Portal.
Obfuscated: Specific data is obfuscated in the Business Insights Admin Portal for the admin.
None: Doesn’t allow admins access to the feature.

role-permission-categories.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Each role needs permissions in General Permissions (administrator management, remote assistance management, ZIA user management, ZIA location management), Module Permissions, Feature Permissions and Data Visibility.

quotes: For each role you configure, you must assign permissions in the following categories:
Administrator Management (Administration > Administration Management)
Remote Assistance Management (Help > Remote Assistance)
ZIA User Management (Administration > ZIA Users)
ZIA Location Management (Administration > ZIA Locations)
The Data Visibility permission allows you to view or obfuscate the usernames throughout the Business Insights Admin Portal for the role.
For Module Permissions, admins can view and manage the following Business Insights modules:
For Feature Permissions, admins can configure scheduled reports and set up Workflow Automation

role-module-feature-permissions.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Module Permissions cover Application Insights, All Applications, Application Settings, Workplaces and All Contracts, and Feature Permissions cover scheduled reports, Workflow Automation and system-generated reports.

quotes: Application Insights (Applications > Application Insights)
Application Settings (Applications > Application Settings)
All Contracts (Applications > All Contracts)
For Feature Permissions, admins can configure scheduled reports and set up Workflow Automation, or view system-generated reports under the Reports section.
All Applications (Applications > All Applications)
Workplaces (all the modules inside the Workplaces section)

role-prerequisites.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Configuring an admin role requires the proper permissions and organizational scope.

quotes: You must have the proper permissions to configure a role.
You must have organizational scope.

default-admin.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, The default admin account can be enabled or disabled but not deleted, and for an account subscribed to Authentication Service, whose admins are configured in the Authentication Service Admin Portal, the Administrators page allows editing only an existing admin's scope.

quotes: Enable or disable the default admin account status, but you cannot delete the account.

On the Administrators page, you can only edit an existing admin's scope if you are subscribed to the Authentication Service service. These admins are configured in the Authentication Service Admin Portal.

admin-scope-options.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, An admin's scope is Organization (all areas), Offices (specific configured offices) or Office Geolocations (offices by geography).

quotes: Organization: Provides the ability to manage all areas in the Business Insights Admin Portal.
Offices: Select admin scope over specific configured offices.
Office Geolocations: Select admin scope over configured offices based on the geography

admin-field-limits.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, An admin's comments cannot exceed 10,240 characters, and a password for password-based login is 8 to 100 characters with a number, a special character and an uppercase letter.

quotes: The comments cannot exceed 10,240 characters.
It can be 8 to 100 characters and must contain at least one number, one special character, and one uppercase letter.

admin-login-type.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, The Administrators list shows each admin's Login Type, which is SAML SSO, direct password login, or both.

quotes: Login Type: Lists if SAML single sign-on (SSO) login, direct password access login, or both are enabled for the admin.

audit-log-fields.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Audit Logs filter by Time Range, Action, Category, Sub-Category or Result, search by Resource, Admin ID or Client IP, and show an Interface that is currently BI UI for all logs.

quotes: Filter by Time Range, Action, Category, Sub-Category, or Result.
Search for logs by Resource, Admin ID, or Client IP.
Currently, the interface is BI UI for all logs, which means Business Insights UI.

audit-log-export.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Timestamps in the audit log CSV download are in PDT, and logs for certain changes show previous values in red and updated values in green.

quotes: The timestamps in the CSV file are in PDT.
The red section shows the previous values and the green section shows the updated values.
View the change in settings performed by the user for certain logs.

zia-sync-pages.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, The ZIA Users page shows user data synced from the ZIA tenant, with a Status of Enabled or Disabled.

quotes: Any user configuration or changes that you make on the User Management pages in the ZIA Admin Portal are synced to this page.
Status: The status of the user (Enabled or Disabled).

zia-locations-fields.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, The ZIA Locations page lists, per location, the number of sublocations and the static IP addresses of its local gateway, and can be downloaded to CSV.

quotes: Sublocations: The number of sublocations, if any.
IP Addresses: The static IP addresses of the local gateway for the location.
Download the data to a CSV file.

csv-export-timezone.summary: The profile time zone is described as applying to CSV log exports, while the audit log CSV is described as using PDT.

quotes: The time zone is used only for exporting logs to CSV files.

positions.says: The time zone chosen in the admin profile is used only for exporting logs to CSV files.

quotes: The timestamps in the CSV file are in PDT.

positions.says: Timestamps in the audit log CSV file are in PDT.

csv-export-timezone.impact: Whether an audit log CSV export uses the admin's profile time zone or PDT is not stated.
